About Me

A Student Who Builds & Explores

Hi! I'm Kanak C. Padgilwar, a first-year Computer Science Engineering student from Alandi, Maharashtra. I'm driven by curiosity about how technology shapes the world — and how I can be part of building it.

My academics have given me strong foundations in programming, data structures, and web development. I approach every project as a problem-solver — breaking complex challenges into clean, effective solutions.

Beyond code, I believe growth happens in every area of life. I love to travel and explore new cultures, express myself through dance and singing, and stay active on the badminton court.
